balls.text: right in the blockhole. Yorker, curls in on middle and leg. Dhoni wrestles it away in front of square on the leg side
Bravo manufactures room by stepping outside leg, Morris delivers a low full toss, which is slapped over his head
Morris digs it short and just outside off as Dhoni nips down the track and flat-bats it to long-on. Rahane keeps it to one
Morris nails a yorker outside off, Dhoni swings and can't connect
banged in short and rises on middle, mishit pull over midwicket after swivelling through the hips
low full toss as the yorker goes wrong, carved over cover-point and CSK pass 150
17 runs off the penultimate over. He hunts for a yorker, slips in a full toss, which is scythed over the covers after Dhoni had reached out. Sweeper is beaten
near yorker outside off, he can't dig it out

Was that into the I,J or K stand? On a length and outside off, Dhoni clears his front leg and whacks it about 20 rows over one of those empty stands. The MA Chidambaram Stadium raises itself to a roar
back of a length and angling away outside off, Bravo rides it to short third man
back of the hand slower one, the Faulkner special. Bravo squirts it through midwicket off the inner part of the bat. They press on for a couple
loads of width on offer outside off. Bravo reaches out, throws his bat at it. Yanks one hand off the bat but manages to carve it over backward point
overpitched and outside off, Bravo drives it to long-off with some Caribbean-esque flourish
yorker swerves in on middle, Dhoni jams his bat down and manages an inside edge onto the pad. The ball rolls to off
low full toss on off, whippily driven to long-on. Hat-trick averted

Twin strike from Morris. Full in length on middle, Negi backs away and toe-ends the attempted slap to the covers, where Smith reverse cups his hands around it. No mistake from Smith. This did not need a jump. Negi throws his head back.

Baz's effort comes to an end, sharp catch from Ankit. This was banged in short, climbs on a middle-stump line. Baz attempts a pull and can only top-edge it. Ankit runs in from long leg, dives forward and takes a smart catch
very full and outside off, flat-batted fiercely to deep cover
Baz has smoked the pants off it. Fuller length on off, he goes deep in the crease and bashes it over long-on
on a length and on middle, pressed to off for a quick one
length on off, down the track and flat-batted to long-off
width on offer outside off, he runs down the track, slashes with all his might and the thick outside edge races through vacant slip cordon

Faf has been run out, Watson nails the stumps down at the non-strikers' in his follow through. Baz fails to connect with the attempted reverse-ramp again, Faf wants a single but is sent back. The ball rolls off the pad to the leg side, Watson runs forward, collects, turns back and fires a direct hit
on a good length and outside off, he aims for a reverse-scoop and misses
back of a length and swerving away wide outside off, past the tram-line. Wided
length and outside off, Baz camps back, ventures deep in the crease and slaps it down the ground. Not middled
Baz shows signs of shuffling across, pushed very full and outside off, carved up and over backward point
Baz shuffles across off and clobbers this short ball over midwicket. Morris runs across to his right in the deep, slides and keeps it to two
on a length and outside off, stops on Faf, who spoons it in front of point. The fielder (Bhatia) misses the direct hit, Baz is in
on a length and outside off, Baz swings hard, loses his balance and mishits it to long-off
fullish and angling away outside off at 130ks, Baz goes for a swipe across the line and only meets with thin air
down the track comes Faf, hurled in outside off, jabbed back towards the bowler off the toe-end
Dropped.Sanju's night has gotten worse. This was darted flat on middle, Faf makes room again, this time for the cut. Nicks it, but Sanju can't hold onto the outside edge. Not an easy chance, though
Faf now steps away outside leg, Ankit chases him with a short ball. He controls a pull between deep midwicket and long-on
short and outside leg, following Baz who was backing away and stepping out. Quietly nudged to leg
Baz loads it, the bowler loses his cool and slips it wide outside off, past the tram-line. Sanju loses his cool and is beaten
Faf skips out, the bowler is wary of it as he shortens his length. Faf bunts it towards wide long-on
flat on middle, Faf makes room and chops to the covers
shortish and outside off, Baz steps away and lashes it past the covers. Long-off runs to his left and hunts it down
away she sails into the crowd. Length on middle, Baz stands still and launches it over deep midwicket with brutal power
he comes down the track, yorks himself and squeezes it out
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket
back of a length and outside off, slapped to the covers
overpitched and outside off, slow in pace off the back of the hand. Baz plants his front foot forward and lifts it over the covers
dropped short on off, Faf rocks back and pulls it strongly to the cow-corner boundary
takes it from a middle-stump line and whippily drives it through midwicket for a fifty. Baz elicits a heathy round of applause from the big crowd
fuller on middle, driven to leg off the inner part of the bat for one
darted flat and quick outside off, carved away through the covers. Sweeper mops it up in the deep
ripping legbreak. Looped up and spins away past the outside edge. This left Faf prodding and missing. Ashwin would like this turn
Baz steps out, manufactures a full toss and drills a drive to long-off
back of the hand slower one outside off and Faulkner has the propensity to derive extra bounce with it, Baz waits on it before dragging a pull to deep midwicket
hoho! Faulkner can afford only a wry smile. Length on middle, Baz goes low and ramps it beautifully over the keeper's head. No power here, just some healthy helping of cheek
Faulkner drops it short at 127ks, Baz advances down the track and flat-bats it past a diving Smith at the covers. Slapped away dismissively after missing the last three
floated up and outside off, Baz reaches out but can't slip it away. He can't put bat on it
shortish and outside off, Baz swings and can't connect again
on a length and angling away, Baz slogs and misses. It slides under the bat of Baz. He was hoodwinked by the change of pace
back of a length and on middle at 85ks, goes on the back foot and forces it to long-on. End of a tight over from Bhatia
back of a length and outside off, Faf waits for it to arrive and flicks it towards cow corner
floated up outside off at 91ks, pushed feebly back to the bowler
rolls his fingers across this cutter, tucked away off the pads behind square leg
slower and outside off at 87ks, whipped to long-on. Faf can't manufacture his own pace
too leg-stumpish and slow, tickled past the keeper fine on the leg side. The ball dribbled away off the pad
room outside off, spins away further, Faf camps back and cracks it to the covers
whipped away from outside off through midwicket. Ankit chases and limits it to one
tossed up on middle, Baz sets up for a ramp, does it connect well. The ball goes in the air in between the keeper and first slip
down the track and dragged over mid-on. Smith leaps in the air, he finger-tipped it away as well
Baz sinks to one knee, fetches this from outside off and smashes it to the deep square leg boundary, one bounce four. Swept powerfully
on a length and turns away, pushed to the covers after stepping on the back foot
pushed through flatter and quicker, googly, beats Baz and strikes him on the front pad. Baz weathers the lbw appeal. Outside the line of off
tossed up and around off, Baz defensively pushes it
on a length and on off, blocked back to the bowler
looped up and looked like the googly. Calmly defended. Tambe had delivered it from behind the stumps
pushed through on middle, now its Faf's turn to secure a single to long-off
flighted and full on off, driven smoothly to long-off
back of a length and on middle, tucked away past midwicket

typical, Baz! On a length and outside off, Baz seeks to ramp it fine on the leg side. Checks his shot off the last moment and reverse-scoops it fine on the off side over Samson. Quite close to the helmet of the keeper
slow cutter on off, he rolls his fingers across it. Defended quiety
on a length and just a shade outside off, guided to point off the face
dug in shortish and outside off, Faf whirls his wrists and directs it to wide long-on
slowy on middle and leg at 108ks, tapped towards long-on
on a length and outside off, Baz slashes it to the off-side sweeper on the bounce
back of a length, room on offer. Baz opens the face of the bat and dabs it through the vacant slip cordon after beating the keeper. More off an outside edge
back of a length and outside off at 114ks, much slowy in pace. Punched to point, Rahane flings to his right and makes a good save
Faf opens the face of his bat on impact with this 128ks back-of-a-length ball around off and glides it to deep third man
back of a length and outside off, Baz employs the latest of late cuts but finds the man at point
shortish and angling across, Baz opts for caution, swaying his upper body out of the way
back of a length and outside off, punched to long-off
on a length and on middle, Baz nips down the track and launches it over the long-on. This was not flat, it soared over the sightscreen
slider from Tambe, Baz gets an inside edge onto the pad
full and outside off, pushed to the covers
pushed through just outside off, stops on Baz, who nearly lobbed it back for a return catch
Tambe loops it up outside off, Baz makes a bit of room and sends it screaming over the covers for a flattish six
pushed through on middle and leg, tapped to the right of mid-on
stumping chance. They refer it to the TV umpire. Floated up and spins away outside off, Baz swings and misses. His back foot was grounded even as Sanju whipped the bails off
pushed to the right of the bowler

Smith almost pulled off a top catch at short cover. Tossed up and around off, he looks to drive, hits it in the air. Smith leaps up and can only fingertip it away. Perhaps, Smith did not time his jump to perfection
threads the gap now.. Flatter and turns away outside off, punched in front of square on the off side
flatter and quicker outside off, punched off the back foot to extra-cover
on a length and outside off, dabbed with soft hands to the right of Watson at slip. He dives and makes a half-stop. Faf opens his account
veering down leg, Morris' radar goes haywire. Faf can't connect with the glance. Good take from Sanju
on a length and on off, blocked back to the bowler

Raina picks out mid-off. Two in two for the Royals.. Morris follows up a couple of shortish balls with a length-delivery outside off, Raina camps back, seeks to drive and ends up chipping it to mid-off. Faulkner helps himself to a simpler catch. He takes a high-five from Smith
back of a length on middle, Raina hops up and quells it in front of square on the leg side
aha! There comes the short ball. Morris tests Raina, who goes for a pull and only meets with thin air
fuller length on off, Raina strides forward, presses it to the covers and half-waves his bat to Baz
length on middle, Raina dances down the track and whips it over midwicket. Long-on hunts it down in the deep
picked away off the pads behind square leg and Raina gets off the mark

Smith holes out to mid-on and Ankit strikes with his fourth ball. Ankit had given this more air outside off, Smith attempts a swipe over the leg side, he can only drag it to mid-on off the inner part of the bat. Faulkner comes in, dives forward to snap it up
too full and straight, clipped through midwicket
Ankit held this one back, Baz pushes and lobs it in the air to the left of the bowler
flat and full on off, driven back at the bowler
back of a length and outside off, Smith loads up for a short-arm pull, only drags it onto his thigh pad off an inner edge
Baz calls for one and Smith responds. Punched towards cover-point
short and comes in on middle, Baz is cramped for room. He awkwardly blocks it to leg
pitched up and outside off, Smith employs an open face and drives it behind point, towards deep third man
Watson shortens his length further, the line is close to off. Smith gets on top of the bounce and blocks it back to the bowler
Hello Watson says Smith. Back of a length and outside off, width on offer and Smith punches it in the gap at the covers
I expected that! We all would have expected that. Baz comes down the track, nay he races down the track and hoists it over mid-on
back of a length and outside off, Smith chases it, slashing it to the right of deep third man. Tambe mops it up in the deep
keeps it short and tests Smith, who camps back and punchily blocks it to midwicket
much shorter. Bumper, boings through to the keeper as Smith sways his head out of the way
banged in short and top-of-off line, Smith pushes it back to the bowler
short and smacks Smith on the thigh. Some extra bounce on it to beat Smith on the short-arm pull
CSK reclaim the top spot! Banged in short and outside off, pulled to long-on. The MA Chidambaram Stadium raises itself to a huge roar
Tambe sinks to one knee, slog-sweeps and gets a toe end to the off side
slower ball, length and outside off, Ankit Sharma slogs and gets a thick edge to short third man, Nehra takes a fine overhead catch there
drilled down to long-on, just a single
length and outside off, slapped over the bowler's head for a couple
slower back of a length ball outside off, dragged to deep midwicket. They take two. Dhoni is not happy with Jaddu's effort
slips in a waist-high full toss down leg, helped away over short fine leg for a six. Over the waistline. No ball
low full toss outside off, slapped past the covers
I suspect  that's a slower ball. Swing and a miss. Hat-trick averted

Faf completes a sharp catch now. Back of the hand slower ball outside off at 102ks, Bhatia comes down the track and slices it. Faf moves to his right from backward point, takes it and tumbles onto the ground. He is down, clutching his hamstring. He has a smile on his face as well. Thanks for coming, Bhatia.

DJ Bravo, you beauty! What a night he is having. He pulls off another top catch. He shows off his moves again. This was a low full toss around off, Faulkner slaps it in the air, Bravo leaps off his feet, time time at cover and snaffles it! He loves to dance to the crowd....
Can you believe it, Baz has dropped it. Change-up outside off, Morris slices it. Baz runs to his left from long-off and spills it. It pops in and pops out.
high full toss on a leg-stump line, clubbed away behind square leg. Erasmus' arm goes up straightaway at square leg, it was above the waistline
full toss outside off, this time Morris succeeds in slapping it to the off-side sweeper
slower ball outside off at 103ks, past the tram-line. Morris can't reach out and slap it away
flicks this slowy ball from outside off to long-on
low full toss on middle and leg, flicked to long-on

The West Indian combo does it! Another of the slow balls outside off, Samson goes for an encore. Charges down the track, Swings hard and Smith runs in from sweeper cover to pouch it. Good catch from Smith and Bravo snatches the purple cap from Nehraji
108ks, length ball outside off, Sanju steps down the track and hammers it over deep midwicket for a huge six
yorker, dug out back to the bowler

Samson loses his bat, Bravo drops a catch! Its all happening at the MA Chidambaram Stadium. Sanju throws his bat at this slower ball rather literally, it swings in the air and lands in front of square leg. The top edge pops over DJ, who moves back and shells it. In and out
mighty full right at the base of the stumps, drilled to long-on
half-tracker on middle, Faulkner rocks back and pulls firmly. Smith gets across, bends low and limits it to one
on a length and on middle, change-up from Nehra. He backs away and pushes it past the covers
Faulkner comes down the track, gets a full toss and lashes it past a diving Baz at the covers to long-off
short and on the hips, semi-paddled and semi-pulled to the left of short fine leg. With fine leg in the circle, one can't afford to ball such loose balls
low full toss on off, pushed to the covers. Baz swoops down on the ball quickly and misses a direct hit. Sanju, who had taken a start, turns back, dives and makes his ground
change of pace on middle and leg, knocked in front of midwicket for one
Smith is lazy to bend down again, concedes a four. Back of a length and outside off, thrashed through point. Smith runs across to his left from sweeper and makes a meal of it
slower ball again, Samson walks down the track and tucks it to midwicket
pummeled! Fuller length on off, slower cutter. Sanju goes down on one knee, manufactures own pace and slog-sweeps it high and over deep midwicket
slower length ball on middle, turned through midwicket
back of a length and outside off, he looks to drive and chips it in front of the covers. Baz collects the ball quickly but fails to nail a direct hit
down the track and hacked to deep midwicket
Fired at 92ks, hits Samson on the front pad, but this was sliding down leg. The ball loops off the pad, Dhoni takes it. But no bat or glove involved. The caught-behind appeal is shot down
fuller and on of, forward and eased to long-off
Jaddu fires a flat dart and strikes Faulkner on the back pad I guess. This was snaking down leg
on the pads, clipped to the left of short fine

Jaddu strikes again, 4 for 8. Pushed through on off, Hooda steps out, manufactures a full toss. Instead of mowing it away, he mishits the lofted stroke and holes out to long-on. Suresh Raina steadies under it and snaffles a good overhead catch before tumbling onto the ground
another of those slower balls, the line is on leg, Hooda nurdles a single fine on the leg side
loopy slower ball on off, quietly blocked
length on off, slower ball. Clipped away behind square leg
normal pace, too full and on middle and leg. Whipped away in front of square on the leg side
slowy full ball on off, knocked in front of midwicket for one
starts off with an offuctter, worked to midwicket
pitched up and outside off, driven to deep cover
floated on leg stump, tickled to short fine leg
flat and down leg, wide called
slid through outside off, cut off the back foot to the right of a diving first slip, behind point. Skips to the boundary
pushed through, played back to the bowler
flatter and outside off, punched off the back foot to long-on
full on off, he nips down the track and whips it to long-on
straight roller on off, blocked back to Jaddu

third wicket for Jaddu! Looped up and outside off, Karn sinks to one knee for a slog sweep and lobs it into the hands of Ashwin at short fine leg. Top edge, Dolly catch, soft dismissal. Jaddu blows kisses and looks skywards
fuller and outside off, driven past extra-cover. Two is the call but they get only one
tossed up and outside off, he goes low, misses the sweep and is hit just below the shoulder. Weathers the lbw appeal, it was bouncing over the stumps
darted in at 95ks, he misses the flick. Off the pad and they sneak in a leg bye
fullish and on middle, laced down to long-off
Negi gives this more air outside off, Hooda charges down the track and lifts it over the covers
Negi shortens his length as Hooda comes down the track. Defended quietly
played past the covers
tossed up on middle with some turn away, dabbed to the off side
down the track and driven past the covers
whipped to leg

DJ Bravo pulls off an absolute blinder! He sets off on a celebratory sprint towards long-off. Could that be a game-changer like how he had run out Kohli on his follow through earlier in the tournament? The crowd loving this. This was full and on middle, Watson presses forward and lofts it in the air. It seemed destined to go over the ropes.... until Bravo at long-on leaps off his feet, stretches his right hand and plucks out a superb one-handed catch. He also held his balance, ensuring that the momentum did not take him over. Bravo then breaks into a customary jig before being flanked by Raina. Oh boy, Bravo is a crowd-pleaser. Isn't he?
length outside off, Karun backs away and slashes it to long-off
shortish on off, Watson goes deep in the crease and pulls it to long-on
darted in on off, pushed to the left of the bowler
tossed up and outside off, Karun leans forward and eases it past the covers
flatter and on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket
half-track on the leg stump, Watson rocks back and pulls it over square leg

misfield, this time from Faf.. Full and outside off, Watson bends his knee and drills a drive to the left of the covers. Faf runs across from long-off, slides and lands on the ball. It runs away to the boundary
Watson backs away and forces this flat ball to the covers
back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers
fuller and on middle, be sinks to one knee and sweeps it over midwicket. Lax effort from Smith as he runs across to his left, gets only one hand to it and concedes a four
tossed up on middle, Negi gets some spin. Defended
full again, driven inside out past the covers
full on off, pushed to the covers

Timber or a stumping chance? They go to the TV umpire. Smith shakes his head while Dhoni is confident. Jaddu gets Smith. Pushed through, Smith shuffles across off and misses the sweep completely, the ball hits the leg stump and dislodges the bails. Crucial wicket for the hosts
flat on middle, punched to leg
slid through quick outside off, crashed to the off-side sweeper
flat dart on the pads, Watson can't connect with the glance
fullish and on middle and leg, nudged to midwicket
slides in on back of a length. Arm-ball, he goes on the back foot and pushes wide of the covers
darted down leg, Negi gets away it as Watson helps it to Nehra at deep fine leg with a sweep
full on off, down the track and Smith executes a wristy drive to mid-on
pitched up and just a shade outside off, driven to the left of the covers
flat and outside off, slapped through the covers
back of a length on middle, Smith goes back and across to work it to leg
length on middle, Watson looks to flick, it goes wrong. Gets a leading edge that pops between covers and point
full and outside off, crunched to the covers, where Smith dives to his right and makes a half-stop. The pair take two

The short ball consumes Rahane. Dug in short on the stumps, Rahane attempts a pull and has to settle with a top-edge. This one got big on Rahane. DJ Bravo runs forward from deep square leg and takes it
length on off, glanced fine on the leg side. Bravo runs across from backward square leg and limits it to two
slower full ball on middle, sliced over the covers. Faf in action again, he runs back from mid-off, puts in another outstanding slide near the boundary and swats the ball in
fired on a back of a length, Watson punches it hard into the ground, near the short-cover region. Mohit runs forward and across to collect the ball. They sneak a single, though
fractionally short and wide outside off, Watson cuts it to the right of backward point. Skips away to the boundary
back of a length and on the hips, pulled tentatively behind square leg
very full and on of, Rahane gets under it and hoists it over the bowler. Beats Bravo to his left at mid-on. Dhoni shakes his head
short on the stumps, does not rise much. Watson adjusts and pulls it through midwicket. Dwayne Smith has it covered in the deep
Watson flashes and misses this cutter outside off. Beaten for the change of pace
on a length and outside off, Rahane's bat twists as he mih-hits the loft over the covers. Faf runs back from mid-off, slides and hauls the ball before the boundary. The result is only a couple
back of a length and around off, punched down the ground. The pair refuse to take on Faf's arm
on a length and on off, drilled down the ground. Faf dives to his right from mid-off and stops the ball
change-up. Slower short one on off, nudged in front of square leg for one
Rahane pulls and beats DJ Bravo. Rahane controls a pull off a short one, Bravo runs across, dives to his left from deep square and gets beaten
banged in short and rises on off, Watson goes on the back foot. He does not flinch, playing a pull in front of square on the leg side
too full and straight, flicked through midwicket
length on off, forward and mistimed drive to mid-off
back of a length, angling away around off, knocked in front of point with an open face
back of a length and on middle, turned behind square leg. There is a fumble from Mohit, but the opening pair settle with one
parcelled up and dispatched! Length on off, too full in fact. Rahane takes a step forward and lofts it over mid-on
good length and angling away outside off, Rahane is lured into a push. The extra zip and bounce beats Rahane
banged in short and Watson rocks back for the pull. Mishit it to cow corner. DJ Bravo runs across to his left from deep midwicket, keeping it to two
fuller and on middle, Watson pushes it to mid-off
full and outside off, Watson comes forward, lays into a crisp cover-drive but finds Rahane
dug in on a back of a length, Watson stays back and flays it to mid-off
pitched up on off, Watson hangs back and punches to the covers
back of a length and moves in off the deck on off, Watson has a lazy push and gets an inside edge onto the pad
fuller length and swings in on middle, blocked to mid-on
fuller and outside off, gently chipped over cover-point. No power, just good timing
on a length and on off, forward and pushed down to mid-off
on a good length and goes away with the angle outside off, Rahane chases with a feeble drive and is beaten. Might have been a quick offcutter
fuller and swings back in on off, Rahane pushes and gets an inside edge onto the pad
first ball.. pitched up and outside off, left alone like how Chris Gayle did in the first game today
